At the top of the {wiki:Asura Palace}, in Tiquanda, there are sealed doors that only open after you kill groups of creatures hidden in secret rooms all over the tower. Fight your way to the three bosses — {creature:The Moonlight Aster}, {creature:The Flaming Orchid} and {creature:The Winter Bloom} — and take the chance to open the two chests on the top floor, with 3 {item:Small Ruby|Small Rubies} and 3 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires}.
A mysterious door in a mysterious palace...
For the achievement **Lost Palace Raider** you must have completed the {wiki:The Lost Brother Quest} beforehand.

Accept the {wiki:The Lost Brother Quest} mission from its NPC first: that way you do both quests at the same time and save time.
The kills that open the doors are **individual**. In a team, the others can block and heal you, but **cannot attack** the creatures (just like in the {wiki:Nightmare Teddy Quest}).
Kills are saved: you can leave the palace and come back later without losing them.

Go to the {wiki:Asura Palace}, in {wiki:Tiquanda} (near Port Hope), by the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass|Kha'zeel Pass}: it is **north** of {npc:Tarun}, the merchant near the wooden bridge of the pass. The simplest way is from **Ankrahmun**: leave the city to the **west** and climb the mountains ({creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}), cross the bridge up there (there is a {creature:Nomad} and some {creature:Bandit|Bandits}) and go down until you reach a staircase that takes you to the jungle side. You can also come on foot from **Port Hope**, east through the Tiquanda jungle.

The palace is full of {creature:Dawnfire Asura|Dawnfire Asuri}, {creature:Midnight Asura|Midnight Asuri}, {creature:Frost Flower Asura|Frost Flower Asuri} and {creature:Hellspawn|Hellspawns}.
There are 3 bosses behind sealed doors ({item:Sealed Door}). Each one only opens after you kill its groups of creatures, hidden in secret rooms under holes scattered around the tower:
Cellar (-1), the same as the Liches
If you try to open the door too early you see: *"You see the images of liches, fire and energy elementals, hydras and destroyers over the doorframe. They're dark and faint."*
The fastest way is to start in the cellar (-1) and work your way up. After each room, climb back up.

On the ground floor, go to the far **west** part and step on the {item:Some Cracks (Hole)|cracks in the floor}. Down there kill **2** {creature:Vicious Lich|Vicious Liches} and **1** {creature:Solitary Frost Dragon}. Climb back up.
Cracks to the Liches/Frost Dragon room
Go to the small patch of **grass** on the ground floor and fall into the {item:Pitfall}. Kill the **3** {creature:Cave Hydra|Cave Hydras} and climb back up.
Go up **1 floor** and go to the far **northeast** part (right). Fall through the cracks and kill the **2** {creature:Greater Energy Elemental|Greater Energy Elementals}. Climb back up.
Go up to the **3rd floor** and fall through the cracks **southwest** of the grass patch (left). Kill the **2** {creature:Vile Destroyer|Vile Destroyers} and climb back up.
Cracks (3rd floor, southwest of the grass)
Go up to the **4th floor** and fall through the cracks in the far **northeast** part (right). Kill the **2** {creature:Greater Fire Elemental|Greater Fire Elementals} and climb back up.
Top floor: The Moonlight Aster and The Flaming Orchid

Go up to the **top floor** (+5). There are two boss rooms behind {item:Sealed Door|sealed doors}: the one on the **left** is {creature:The Moonlight Aster}'s and the one on the **right** is {creature:The Flaming Orchid}'s. Go in and kill both.
Boss loot; achievement **Lost Palace Raider** when killing The Flaming Orchid, if you have already completed The Lost Brother Quest
On the highest floor of the **west** part of the tower there is a chest: open it.
On the highest floor of the **east** part of the tower there is a {item:Sarcophagus (Quest)|sarcophagus}: open it.
Go back down to the start (the hole in the west of the ground floor, the Liches and Frost Dragon room) to reach the {creature:The Winter Bloom} boss room and kill it.

Climb up from the cellar the same way you fell (use the {item:Rope} if needed) and leave the palace by the ground-floor entrance. Go back **south** to {npc:Tarun} and from there follow the Kha'zeel Pass to **Ankrahmun** (the way you came, in reverse) or go back through the jungle to Port Hope.
Kills are saved: you can leave halfway and come back later.

To save time next time: after killing The Winter Bloom, kill the Frost Dragon, the Liches, the Hydras and the Energy Elementals right away and leave the palace. The kills remain valid when you come back: next time you only need to go up, kill the Destroyers and the Fire Elementals, do the 2 bosses at the top and go down to the cellar boss.
